verses.text: “You go make di altar of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide. Di altar go be square, and im height go be three cubits.
You go make im horns on im four corners. Im horns go be of one piece with am, and you go overlay am with bronze.
You go make im pots to take away im ashes, and im shovels, im basins, im forks, and im fire pans. You go make all im vessels of bronze.
You go make for am one grating of network of bronze. On di network you go make four bronze rings for im four corners.
You go put am under di ledge of di altar beneath, so that di network go reach halfway up di altar.
You go make poles for di altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay dem with bronze.
Dem go put im poles into di rings, and di poles go dey on di two sides of di altar, when e dey carried.
You go make am hollow with boards. As e dey show you for di mountain, na so dem go make am.
You go make di court of di tabernacle. For di south side toward di south, di court go get hangings of fine twined linen 100 cubits long for one side.
Im pillars go be 20, and dem sockets 20, of bronze. Di hooks of di pillars and dem fillets go be of silver.
Likewise for di north side in length, dere go dey hangings 100 cubits long, and im pillars 20, and dem sockets 20, of bronze. Di hooks of di pillars and dem fillets go be of silver.
For di width of di court on di west side go be hangings of 50 cubits. Dem pillars go be ten, and dem sockets ten.
Di width of di court on di east side toward di sunrise go be 50 cubits.
Di hangings for di one side of di gate go be 15 cubits. Dem pillars go be three, and dem sockets three.
For di other side go be hangings of 15 cubits. Dem pillars go be three, and dem sockets three.
For di gate of di court go be one screen of 20 cubits, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, di work of one embroiderer. Dem pillars go be four, and dem sockets four.
All di pillars round di court go dey filleted with silver. Dem hooks go be of silver, and dem sockets of bronze.
Di length of di court go be 100 cubits, and di width 50 everywhere, and di height five cubits, of fine twined linen, and dem sockets of bronze.
All di vessels of di tabernacle for all im service, and all im pegs, and all di pegs of di court, go be of bronze.
You go command di pikin dem of Israel say dem go bring to you pure beaten olive oil for di light, to cause one lamp to burn continually.

For di Tent of Meeting, outside di veil wey dey before di testimony, Aaron and im pikin man dem go keep am in order from evening to morning before di Lord. Dis go be one statute forever throughout dem generations for di pikin dem of Israel.”

“Bring near to yourself Aaron your brother, and im pikin man dem with am, from among di pikin dem of Israel, so that e go minister to me for di priest office, Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron pikin man dem.
You go make holy garments for Aaron your brother, for glory and for beauty.
You go speak to all wey dey skillful, wey I don fill with di spirit of wisdom, so that dem go make Aaron garments to make am holy, so that e go minister to me for di priest office.

Dem na di garments wey dem go make: one breastplate, one ephod, one robe, one coat of checker work, one turban, and one sash. Dem go make holy garments for Aaron your brother and im pikin man dem, so that e go minister to me for di priest office.
Dem go take di gold, di blue, di purple, di scarlet, and di fine linen.
Dem go make di ephod of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with skillful work.
E go get two shoulder pieces joined to di two ends of am, so that e go dey joined together.
Di skillfully woven band, wey dey on am, to fasten am on, go be of di same piece, according to im work: of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.
You go take two onyx stones, and engrave on dem di names of di pikin dem of Israel:
six of dem names on di one stone, and di names of di six wey remain on di other stone, according to dem birth.

With di work of one engraver on stone, like di engravings of one signet, you go engrave di two stones, according to di names of di pikin dem of Israel. You go make dem to dey enclosed for settings of gold.
You go put di two stones on di shoulder pieces of di ephod, to be stones of memorial for di pikin dem of Israel. Aaron go bear dem names before di Lord on im two shoulders for memorial.
You go make settings of gold,
and two chains of pure gold. You go make dem like cords, of braided work, and you go fasten di braided chains to di settings.
You go make one breastplate of judgment, di work of one skillful workman. Like di work of di ephod you go make am: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen you go make am.
E go be square and doubled, one span im length, and one span im width.
You go set for am settings of stones, four rows of stones: one row of sardius, topaz, and emerald go be di first row.
Di second row go be one turquoise, one sapphire, and one diamond.
Di third row one jacinth, one agate, and one amethyst.
Di fourth row one beryl, one onyx, and one jasper. Dem go dey set for gold for dem settings.
Di stones go be according to di names of di pikin dem of Israel, 12, according to dem names. Dem go be like di engravings of one signet, everyone according to im name, for di 12 tribes.
You go make on di breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.
You go make on di breastplate two rings of gold, and put di two rings on di two ends of di breastplate.
You go put di two braided chains of gold for di two rings for di ends of di breastplate.
Di other two ends of di two braided chains you go fasten for di two settings, and put dem on di shoulder pieces of di ephod for im front.
You go make two rings of gold, and you go put dem on di two ends of di breastplate, upon im edge, wey dey toward di inside of di ephod.
You go make two rings of gold, and put dem on di two shoulder pieces of di ephod underneath, toward im front, close to im coupling, above di skillfully woven band of di ephod.

Dem go bind di breastplate by im rings to di rings of di ephod with one lace of blue, so that e go dey above di skillfully woven band of di ephod, and so that di breastplate no go come loose from di ephod.
Aaron go bear di names of di pikin dem of Israel for di breastplate of judgment upon im heart, when e go into di holy place, for memorial before di Lord continually.

You go put for di breastplate of judgment di Urim and di Thummim. Dem go dey upon Aaron heart, when e go in before di Lord. Aaron go bear di judgment of di pikin dem of Israel upon im heart before di Lord continually.
You go make di robe of di ephod all of blue.
Im opening for di head go dey for di middle of am. E go get one binding of woven work round im opening, like di opening of one coat of mail, so that e no go tear.
For im hem you go make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet, round im hem, and bells of gold between dem round about:
one golden bell and one pomegranate, one golden bell and one pomegranate, upon di hem of di robe round about.
Aaron go dey on am to minister. Im sound go dey heard when e go in to di holy place before di Lord, and when e come out, so that e no go die.
You go make one plate of pure gold, and engrave on am, like di engravings of one signet, ‘HOLY TO DI LORD.’
You go put am on one lace of blue, and e go dey on di turban. E go be on di front of di turban.

E go dey upon Aaron forehead, and Aaron go bear di iniquity of di holy things, wey di pikin dem of Israel go make holy, even all dem holy gifts. E go dey always upon im forehead, so that dem go dey accepted before di Lord.
You go weave di coat in checker work of fine linen, and you go make one turban of fine linen. You go make one sash, di work of one embroiderer.
For Aaron pikin man dem you go make coats, and you go make sashes for dem, and you go make headbands for dem, for glory and for beauty.
You go put dem upon Aaron your brother, and upon im pikin man dem with am, and go anoint dem, and set dem apart, and make dem holy, so that dem go minister to me for di priest office.
You go make dem linen trousers to cover di flesh of nakedness. Dem go reach from di hips even to di thighs.

Dem go dey upon Aaron, and upon im pikin man dem, when dem go in to di Tent of Meeting, or when dem come near to di altar to minister for di holy place, so that dem no go bear iniquity and die. Dis go be one statute forever to am and to im seed after am.”
“Dis na di thing wey you go do to dem to make dem holy, to minister to me for di priest office: take one young bull and two rams without blemish,
and unleavened bread, unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil. You go make dem of fine wheat flour.
You go put dem into one basket, and bring dem for di basket, with di bull and di two rams.
You go bring Aaron and im pikin man dem to di door of di Tent of Meeting, and wash dem with water.
You go take di garments, and put on Aaron di coat, di robe of di ephod, di ephod, and di breastplate, and gird am with di skillfully woven band of di ephod.
You go set di turban on im head, and put di holy crown on di turban.
You go take di anointing oil, and pour am on im head, and anoint am.
You go bring im pikin man dem, and put coats on dem.
You go gird dem with sashes, Aaron and im pikin man dem, and bind headbands on dem. Di priest office go be dem own by one perpetual statute. You go set Aaron and im pikin man dem apart.
You go bring di bull before di Tent of Meeting. Aaron and im pikin man dem go lay dem hands on di head of di bull.
You go kill di bull before di Lord, by di door of di Tent of Meeting.
You go take of di blood of di bull, and put am on di horns of di altar with your finger. You go pour out all di blood at di base of di altar.
You go take all di fat wey cover di inner parts, di cover of di liver, di two kidneys, and di fat wey dey on dem, and burn dem on di altar.
But di flesh of di bull, and im skin, and im dung, you go burn with fire outside di camp. Na sin offering.
You go take one of di rams. Aaron and im pikin man dem go lay dem hands on di head of di ram.
You go kill di ram, and you go take im blood, and sprinkle am round about on di altar.
You go cut di ram into pieces, and wash im inner parts and im legs, and put dem with im pieces and with im head.
You go burn di whole ram on di altar. E na burnt offering to di Lord. E na pleasing aroma, one offering made by fire to di Lord.
You go take di other ram. Aaron and im pikin man dem go lay dem hands on di head of di ram.

You go kill di ram, and take some of im blood, and put am on di tip of di right ear of Aaron, and on di tip of di right ear of im pikin man dem, and on di thumb of dem right hand, and on di big toe of dem right foot, and sprinkle di blood on di altar round about.

You go take of di blood wey dey on di altar, and of di anointing oil, and sprinkle am on Aaron, and on im garments, and on im pikin man dem, and on im pikin man dem garments with am. Aaron go dey holy, and im garments, and im pikin man dem, and im pikin man dem garments with am.

Also you go take di fat from di ram, and di fat tail, and di fat wey cover di inner parts, and di cover of di liver, and di two kidneys, and di fat wey dey on dem, and di right thigh, because na ram of setting apart,
and one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of di basket of unleavened bread wey dey before di Lord.
You go put all dis on di hands of Aaron, and on di hands of im pikin man dem, and wave dem for wave offering before di Lord.
You go take dem from dem hands, and burn dem on di altar on top of di burnt offering, for pleasing aroma before di Lord. E na offering made by fire to di Lord.
You go take di breast of di ram of Aaron setting apart, and wave am for wave offering before di Lord. E go be your portion.

You go make holy di breast of di wave offering, and di thigh of di heave offering, wey dem wave, and wey dem heave up, of di ram of setting apart, even of wetin be Aaron own, and of wetin be im pikin man dem own.

E go be Aaron own and im pikin man dem own by one statute forever from di pikin dem of Israel, because na heave offering. E go be one heave offering from di pikin dem of Israel of di sacrifices of dem peace offerings, even dem heave offering to di Lord.
Di holy garments of Aaron go be im pikin man dem own after am, to dey anointed for dem, and to dey set apart for dem.
Seven days di one among im pikin man dem wey go be priest for im place, wey go come into di Tent of Meeting to minister for di holy place, go put dem on.
You go take di ram of setting apart, and boil im flesh for one holy place.
Aaron and im pikin man dem go eat di flesh of di ram, and di bread wey dey di basket, by di door of di Tent of Meeting.
Dem go eat dem things wey dem don use make atonement, to set apart and to make dem holy. But one stranger no go eat am, because dem dey holy.
If any of di flesh of setting apart, or of di bread, remain until morning, you go burn di remainder with fire. E no go dey eaten, because e dey holy.
Na so you go do to Aaron and to im pikin man dem, according to all wey I don command you. Seven days you go set dem apart.
Every day you go offer one bull of sin offering for atonement. You go make atonement for di altar, when you make atonement for am. You go anoint am, to make am holy.
Seven days you go make atonement for di altar, and make am holy. Di altar go be most holy. Whatever touch di altar go dey holy.
Now dis na wetin you go offer upon di altar: two lambs of one year old day by day continually.
One lamb you go offer for di morning, and di other lamb you go offer for evening.
With di one lamb, one tenth of one ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of one hin of beaten oil, and one fourth of one hin of wine for drink offering.
Di other lamb you go offer for evening, and you go do to am like di meal offering of di morning, and like im drink offering, for pleasing aroma, one offering made by fire to di Lord.
Dis go be one continual burnt offering throughout una generations at di door of di Tent of Meeting before di Lord, wia I go meet with una, to speak dere to you.
Dere I go meet with di pikin dem of Israel, and di Tent of Meeting go dey made holy by my glory.
I go make di Tent of Meeting holy, and di altar. I go make Aaron and im pikin man dem holy too, to minister to me for di priest office.
I go dwell among di pikin dem of Israel, and go be dem God.
Dem go know say I na di Lord dem God, wey bring dem out of di land of Egypt, so that I go dwell among dem. I na di Lord dem God.”
“You go make one altar to burn incense on. You go make am of acacia wood.
Im length go be one cubit, and im width one cubit. E go be square, and im height go be two cubits. Im horns go be of one piece with am.
You go overlay am with pure gold, di top of am, and im sides round about, and im horns. You go make for am one moulding of gold round about.
You go make for am two golden rings under im moulding. Upon im two sides, upon di two sides of am, you go make dem, and dem go be places for di poles to carry am with.
You go make di poles of acacia wood, and overlay dem with gold.
You go put am before di veil wey dey by di ark of di testimony, before di mercy seat wey dey over di testimony, wia I go meet with you.
Aaron go burn on am incense of sweet spices. Every morning when e dey tend di lamps, e go burn am.
When Aaron light di lamps at evening, e go burn am, one perpetual incense before di Lord throughout una generations.
You no go offer strange incense on am, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering. You no go pour drink offering on am.

Aaron go make atonement upon im horns once for di year. With di blood of di sin offering of atonement once for di year, e go make atonement for am throughout una generations. E dey most holy to di Lord.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,

“When you take di census of di pikin dem of Israel, according to dem number, every man go give one ransom for im soul to di Lord, when you number dem, so that no plague go dey among dem, when you number dem.
Dis dem go give, everyone wey pass over to dem wey dey numbered: half shekel, after di shekel of di sanctuary, wey one shekel na 20 gerahs. Half shekel go be di offering to di Lord.
Everyone wey pass over to dem wey dey numbered, from 20 years old and above, go give di offering to di Lord.
Di rich no go give more, and di poor no go give less than half shekel, when dem give di offering to di Lord, to make atonement for una souls.

You go take di atonement money from di pikin dem of Israel, and go appoint am for di service of di Tent of Meeting, so that e go be one memorial for di pikin dem of Israel before di Lord, to make atonement for una souls.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“You go make one basin of bronze, with im base of bronze, for washing. You go put am between di Tent of Meeting and di altar, and you go put water inside am.
Aaron and im pikin man dem go wash dem hands and dem feet for am.
When dem go into di Tent of Meeting, dem go wash with water, so that dem no go die, or when dem come near to di altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire to di Lord.
So dem go wash dem hands and dem feet, so that dem no go die. E go be one statute forever to dem, to am and to im seed throughout dem generations.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Take for yourself principal spices: of liquid myrrh 500 shekels, and of sweet smelling cinnamon half as much, even 250, and of sweet smelling cane 250,
and of cassia 500, after di shekel of di sanctuary, and of olive oil one hin.
You go make am holy anointing oil, one perfume compounded after di art of di perfumer. E go be holy anointing oil.
You go anoint with am di Tent of Meeting, and di ark of di testimony,
and di table and all im vessels, and di lampstand and im vessels, and di altar of incense,
and di altar of burnt offering with all im vessels, and di basin and im base.
You go make dem holy, so that dem go be most holy. Whatever touch dem go dey holy.
You go anoint Aaron and im pikin man dem, and make dem holy, so that dem go minister to me for di priest office.
You go speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘Dis go be one holy anointing oil to me throughout una generations.
E no go dey poured on man flesh, neither una go make any like am, according to im composition. E dey holy. E go be holy to una.
Whoever compound any like am, or whoever put any of am on one stranger, go dey cut off from im people.’”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Take to yourself sweet spices, stacte, onycha, and galbanum, sweet spices with pure frankincense. Of each go be equal weight.
You go make am incense, one perfume after di art of di perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
You go beat some of am very small, and put some of am before di testimony for di Tent of Meeting, wia I go meet with you. E go be to una most holy.
Di incense wey you go make, una no go make for yourselves according to im composition. E go be to you holy for di Lord.
Whoever go make like dat, to smell am, go dey cut off from im people.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Look, I don call by name Bezalel di pikin of Uri, di pikin of Hur, of di tribe of Judah.
I don fill am with God Spirit, for wisdom, for understanding, for knowledge, and for all kinds of workmanship,
to devise skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,
and for cutting of stones for setting, and for carving of wood, to work for all kinds of workmanship.
Look, I don appoint with am Oholiab, di pikin of Ahisamach, of di tribe of Dan. For di hearts of all wey dey wise hearted I don put wisdom, so that dem go make all wey I don command you:
di Tent of Meeting, di ark of di testimony, di mercy seat wey dey on top of am, and all di furnishings of di Tent,
di table and im vessels, di pure lampstand with all im vessels, di altar of incense,
di altar of burnt offering with all im vessels, di basin and im base,
di finely worked garments, di holy garments for Aaron di priest, di garments of im pikin man dem, to minister for di priest office,
di anointing oil, and di sweet incense for di holy place. According to all wey I don command you dem go do.”
Di Lord speak to Moses, talk,
“Speak to di pikin dem of Israel, talk, ‘Surely una go keep my Sabbaths, because na sign between me and una throughout una generations, so that una go know say I na di Lord wey make una holy.
Una go keep di Sabbath therefore, because e dey holy to una. Everyone wey profane am go surely dey put to death, because whoever do any work on am, dat soul go dey cut off from among im people.
Six days dem go do work, but di seventh day na Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to di Lord. Whoever do any work for di Sabbath day go surely dey put to death.
Therefore di pikin dem of Israel go keep di Sabbath, to observe di Sabbath throughout dem generations for one perpetual covenant.
E na sign between me and di pikin dem of Israel forever, because for six days di Lord make heaven and earth, and for di seventh day e rest, and dey refreshed.’”
When e don finish speaking with am on Mount Sinai, e give Moses two tablets of di testimony, tablets of stone, written with God finger.

When di people see say Moses delay to come down from di mountain, di people gather demself together to Aaron, and talk to am, “Come, make us gods, wey go go before us, because as for dis Moses, di man wey bring us up out of di land of Egypt, we no know wetin don happen to am.”
Aaron talk to dem, “Break off di golden rings wey dey di ears of your wives, of your pikin man dem, and of your pikin woman dem, and bring dem to me.”
All di people break off di golden rings wey dey dem ears, and bring dem to Aaron.
E receive wetin dem hand, and fashion am with one graving tool, and make am one molten calf. Dem talk, “Dis na your god, Israel, wey bring you up out of di land of Egypt.”
When Aaron see am, e build one altar before am. Aaron make proclamation, and talk, “Tomorrow go be one feast to di Lord.”
Dem rise up early di next day, offer burnt offerings, and bring peace offerings. Di people sit down to eat and to drink, and rise up to play.
Di Lord speak to Moses, “Go, get down, because your people, wey you bring up out of di land of Egypt, don corrupt demself.

Dem don turn aside quickly out of di way wey I command dem. Dem don make for demself one molten calf, and don worship am, and don sacrifice to am, and talk, ‘Dis na your god, Israel, wey bring you up out of di land of Egypt.’”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “I don see dis people, and look, dem na stiff necked people.
Now therefore leave me alone, so that my wrath go burn hot against dem, and I go consume dem, and I go make of you one great nation.”
Moses plead with di Lord im God, and talk, “Lord, why your wrath burn hot against your people, wey you don bring out of di land of Egypt with great power and with one mighty hand?

Why make di Egyptians talk say, ‘E bring dem out for evil, to kill dem for di mountains, and to consume dem from di surface of di earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and relent of dis evil against your people.

Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to wey you swear by yourself, and talk to dem, ‘I go multiply your seed like di stars of di sky, and all dis land wey I don talk about I go give to your seed, and dem go inherit am forever.’”
Di Lord relent of di evil wey e talk say e go do to im people.
Moses turn, and go down from di mountain, with di two tablets of di testimony for im hand, tablets wey dem write on both dem sides. On di one side and on di other dem write.
Di tablets na di work of God, and di writing na God writing, engraved on di tablets.
When Joshua hear di noise of di people as dem shout, e talk to Moses, “Di noise of war dey for di camp.”
E talk, “No be di voice of dem wey shout for victory, neither na di voice of dem wey cry for being overcome, but di noise of singing wey I hear.”
E come be say, as soon as e come near to di camp, e see di calf and di dancing. Moses anger burn hot, and e throw di tablets out of im hands, and break dem beneath di mountain.
E take di calf wey dem make, and burn am with fire, and grind am to powder, and scatter am on di water, and make di pikin dem of Israel drink am.
Moses talk to Aaron, “Wetin dis people do to you, say you don bring great sin on dem?”
Aaron talk, “Make di anger of my oga no burn hot. You know di people, say dem dey set on evil.
Dem talk to me, ‘Make us gods, wey go go before us, because as for dis Moses, di man wey bring us up out of di land of Egypt, we no know wetin don happen to am.’
I talk to dem, ‘Whoever get any gold, make dem break am off.’ So dem give am to me, and I throw am into di fire, and dis calf come out.”
When Moses see say di people dey out of control, because Aaron don let dem go out of control, to dey shame among dem enemies,
Moses stand for di gate of di camp, and talk, “Whoever dey on di Lord side, make am come to me!” All di pikin dem of Levi gather demself together to am.

E talk to dem, “Di Lord, di God of Israel, talk so: ‘Every man put im sword on im thigh, and go back and forth from gate to gate throughout di camp, and every man kill im brother, and every man im companion, and every man im neighbour.’”
Di pikin dem of Levi do according to di word of Moses. About 3,000 men of di people fall dat day.
Moses talk, “Set yourselves apart today to di Lord, yes, every man against im pikin and against im brother, so that e go bestow on una one blessing today.”
E come be say di next day, Moses talk to di people, “Una don sin one great sin. Now I go go up to di Lord. Maybe I go make atonement for una sin.”
Moses return to di Lord, and talk, “Oh, dis people don sin one great sin, and don make for demself gods of gold.
Yet now, if you go forgive dem sin, make you forgive am. But if you no go, blot me out of your book wey you don write.”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Whoever don sin against me, I go blot am out of my book.
Now go, lead di people to di place wey I don talk to you. Look, my angel go go before you. Nevertheless, for di day wey I visit, I go visit dem for dem sin.”
Di Lord strike di people, because dem make di calf, wey Aaron make.

Di Lord speak to Moses, “Depart, go up from here, you and di people wey you don bring up out of di land of Egypt, to di land wey I swear to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, talk, ‘I go give am to your seed.’
I go send one angel before you, and I go drive out di Canaanite, di Amorite, di Hittite, di Perizzite, di Hivite, and di Jebusite,
to one land wey dey flow with milk and honey. But I no go go up among una, because una dey stiff necked people, so that I no go consume una for di way.”
When di people hear dis bad news, dem mourn, and no man put on im ornaments.

Di Lord talk to Moses, “Say to di pikin dem of Israel, ‘Una dey stiff necked people. If I go up among una for one moment, I go consume una. So now take off your ornaments from you, so that I go know wetin to do to you.’”
Di pikin dem of Israel strip demself of dem ornaments from Mount Horeb onward.

Now Moses dey take di tent and pitch am outside di camp, far from di camp, and e dey call am di Tent of Meeting. E come be say everyone wey seek di Lord go go out to di Tent of Meeting wey dey outside di camp.
E come be say, when Moses go out to di Tent, all di people go rise up, and stand, every man for di door of im tent, and look after Moses, until e don go into di Tent.
E come be say, when Moses enter di Tent, di pillar of cloud go descend, and stand at di door of di Tent, and di Lord go speak with Moses.
All di people go see di pillar of cloud stand at di door of di Tent, and all di people go rise up and worship, every man for di door of im tent.
Di Lord dey speak to Moses face to face, as one man dey speak to im friend. Moses go return into di camp, but im servant Joshua, di pikin of Nun, one young man, no dey depart from di Tent.
Moses talk to di Lord, “Look, you talk to me, ‘Bring up dis people,’ but you no let me know wetin you go send with me. Yet you talk, ‘I know you by name, and you don also find favour for my sight.’
Now therefore, if I don find favour for your sight, show me now your way, so that I go know you, so that I go find favour for your sight. Consider too say dis nation na your people.”
E talk, “My presence go go with you, and I go give you rest.”
Moses talk to am, “If your presence no go with us, no carry us up from here.

Because how go e dey known say I don find favour for your sight, I and your people? No be say you go with us, so that we dey separated, I and your people, from all di people wey dey upon di surface of di earth?”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “I go do dis thing wey you don talk, because you don find favour for my sight, and I know you by name.”
Moses talk, “Show me your glory.”
E talk, “I go make all my goodness pass before you, and I go proclaim di name of di Lord before you. I go be gracious to whom I go be gracious, and I go show mercy on whom I go show mercy.”
E talk, “You no fit see my face, because man no fit see me and live.”
Di Lord talk, “Look, dere dey one place by me, and you go stand on di rock.
E go come be say, while my glory dey pass by, I go put you for one cleft of di rock, and go cover you with my hand until I don pass by.
I go take away my hand, and you go see my back, but my face no go dey seen.”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Cut two tablets of stone like di first. I go write on di tablets di words wey dey di first tablets, wey you break.
Make ready by di morning, and come up in di morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself dere to me on di top of di mountain.
No man go come up with you, neither make any man dey seen throughout all di mountain. Neither make flocks nor herds graze before dat mountain.”
E cut two tablets of stone like di first, and Moses rise up early for morning, and go up to Mount Sinai, as di Lord don command am, and e take for im hand two tablets of stone.
Di Lord descend for di cloud, and stand with am dere, and proclaim di name of di Lord.
Di Lord pass by before am, and proclaim, “Di Lord! Di Lord, God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant for lovingkindness and truth,

keeping lovingkindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin, and e by no means go clear di guilty, visiting di iniquity of di papa dem on di pikin dem, and on di pikin dem pikin dem, on di third and on di fourth generation.”
Moses hurry, and bow im head toward di earth, and worship.
E talk, “If now I don find favour for your sight, Lord, make di Lord go among us, because na stiff necked people dem be. Pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”

E talk, “Look, I dey make one covenant. Before all your people I go do marvels, such as no dey created for all di earth, nor for any nation. All di people wey una dey among dem go see di work of di Lord, because na awesome thing e be wey I go do with you.
Observe wetin I command you today. Look, I dey drive out before you di Amorite, di Canaanite, di Hittite, di Perizzite, di Hivite, and di Jebusite.
Beware say you no make covenant with di inhabitants of di land wia you dey go, otherwise e go be one snare among una.
But una go break down dem altars, and break dem pillars, and cut down dem Asherim.
Because you go worship no other god, because di Lord, wey im name na Jealous, na one jealous God,
otherwise you go make covenant with di inhabitants of di land, and dem play di prostitute after dem gods, and sacrifice to dem gods, and one go call you, and you eat of im sacrifice,
and you take of im pikin woman dem to your pikin man dem, and im pikin woman dem play di prostitute after dem gods, and make your pikin man dem play di prostitute after dem gods.
You go make no molten gods for yourself.
You go keep di feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you go eat unleavened bread, as I command you, for di time appointed of di month Abib, because for di month Abib you come out from Egypt.
All wey open di womb na mine, and all your livestock wey dey male, di firstborn of cow and sheep.
Di firstborn of donkey you go redeem with one lamb. If you no redeem am, you go break im neck. All di firstborn of your pikin man dem you go redeem. None go appear before me empty.
Six days you go work, but on di seventh day you go rest. For plowing time and for harvest you go rest.
You go observe di feast of weeks, even of di firstfruits of wheat harvest, and di feast of ingathering at di year end.
Three times for di year all your males go appear before di Lord, di Lord God of Israel.
Because I go drive out nations before you, and enlarge your borders. Neither go any man covet your land, when you go up to appear before di Lord your God three times for di year.
You no go offer di blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. Di sacrifice of di feast of di Passover no go remain until morning.
Di first of di firstfruits of your ground you go bring to di house of di Lord your God. You no go boil one young goat for im mama milk.”
Di Lord talk to Moses, “Write dem words, because according to di tenor of dem words I don make one covenant with you and with Israel.”
E dey dere with di Lord 40 days and 40 nights. E no eat bread, and e no drink water. E write for di tablets di words of di covenant, di Ten Commandments.

E come be say, when Moses come down from Mount Sinai with di two tablets of di testimony for Moses hand, when e come down from di mountain, Moses no know say di skin of im face shine because e don speak with am.
When Aaron and all di pikin dem of Israel see Moses, look, di skin of im face shine, and dem fear to come near am.
Moses call to dem, and Aaron and all di rulers for di congregation return to am, and Moses talk to dem.
Afterward all di pikin dem of Israel come near, and e give dem as commandment all wey di Lord speak with am for Mount Sinai.
When Moses finish speaking with dem, e put one veil on im face.
But when Moses go in before di Lord to speak with am, e dey take di veil off, until e come out. E come out, and speak to di pikin dem of Israel wetin e dey commanded.
Di pikin dem of Israel see Moses face, say di skin of Moses face shine. Moses put di veil on im face again, until e go in to speak with am.
